load_url_download_checkpoint: download a PyTorch model checkpoint from a URL and load it into memory with caching
load_url_with_hash_check: download a model checkpoint from a URL with SHA256 hash verification enabled
load_url_custom_model_dir: download and load a Torch serialized object from a URL to a custom directory
load_url_with_map_location: download a model checkpoint and load it onto a specific device using map_location
load_url_legacy_zip_support: download a legacy zip format checkpoint and automatically decompress it before loading
